topics.title: AI Agents: Setting Up
topics.name: Coral the Clownfish
points: An agent is an AI model + tools + a loop: think, act, check, repeat.
Start with ONE tiny, boring, repeatable job.
Give it only the tools it needs: search, files, email.
Write clear goals, rules and what 'done' looks like.
Keep a human approving the important steps.
topics.fishFact: Clownfish live safely inside sea anemones, whose stings don't hurt them.

topics.title: Coding in 2026: Basics
topics.name: Pico the Pufferfish
points: You steer, AI types: describe what you want, check what comes back.
Write a short spec first. Vague prompts make vague apps.
Build one feature at a time and save with git after each win.
Learn to read HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript.
Ship it free on GitHub Pages or Netlify.
topics.fishFact: Pufferfish puff up by gulping water, making them a big round ball.

topics.title: Trending AI Tools
topics.name: Angel the Angelfish
points: Chat helpers: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini for thinking and writing.
Code tools: Claude Code and Cursor build real apps with you.
Research: Perplexity and NotebookLM answer from sources.
Create: image and video generators for visuals and clips.
Automate: Zapier and n8n run your boring tasks for you.
topics.fishFact: Many young angelfish look totally different from the adults they grow into.
